sections.Profile:
The Addams Family, released by Midway under the Bally name in March 1992, is a four-player machine designed by Pat Lawlor and Larry DeMar and based on the 1991 film; with 20,270 units produced, it is the highest-selling pinball machine of all time. Players tour the mansion of the creepy and kooky Addams family as they stage an attempt to steal the treasure from their vault, hidden behind a rotating bookcase, while Thing's magnetic hand grabs the ball.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
